jobs.title: Product Owner, Card Programs
jobs.location: Brazil,  Canada,  Costa Rica,  Mexico,  USA
jobs.jd_full:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for super premium, closely held business owners.

We are re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs. From the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, financial operations, all rebuilt from the ground up as a single intelligent system.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, we have scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners with $3M to $200M in revenue. The backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. We are replacing the outdated banks and fragmented tools they are stuck with. The opportunity is a roughly $1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. We are building toward $100B+ in enterprise value by delivering a product that is fundamentally better, not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

What we hold ourselves to: mission-critical problems, high bar low ego, speed over comfort, enduring impact.

Locations: San Francisco, New York, Miami, remote. Open to candidates in Canada, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, and Colombia.

The Role

--------

You will own Flex's card programs end to end. We are running a meaningful annualized credit program today. We are launching multiple new card products in the next two quarters across credit, stablecoin, and rewards. Your job is to scale this from one major program to five-plus and take total volume across the portfolio up by more than an order of magnitude.

This is not a card fulfillment seat. This is the owner of every layer of our card stack: ledger, processing, servicing, fulfillment, BIN sponsor relationships, network relationships, and the operational discipline that lets us run multiple programs concurrently without seams.

We want someone who has personally spun up a card program from scratch, not as a secondary contributor. Someone who can sit in a meeting with a major processor or card network, hear a vendor explanation, and call out exactly where the story is bullshit. Someone who knows what FTS, ARI, DPS, BINs, and the rest of the alphabet actually mean and where vendors hide behind acronyms.

You will partner closely with your engineering counterpart and be on a small team initially. Your first job after landing is to tell us who you need to hire next. This is a business unit builder seat.

What you will do

----------------

Own every layer of Flex's card programs: ledger, processing, servicing, fulfillment, BIN sponsor management, network relationships.

Lead processor strategy and the direct network relationship. Hold vendors accountable. Drive the technical and commercial negotiations.

Build the operational infrastructure that supports five concurrent card programs across credit, stablecoin, and rewards.

Architect the path to scale the portfolio by more than 20x. Build the operating model that makes that scale possible without breaking customer experience.

Recruit the next layer of the card programs team as the function grows. You will tell us who we need to hire and when.

Translate the technical complexity of card issuing into clear product decisions for the rest of the company. We have struggled to communicate the now program, the transition, and the future program. Fixing that is part of your job.

What you will need

------------------

You have personally spun up at least one card program from scratch as the primary owner. If you were the secondary contributor on someone else's program, this is not the seat for you.

Hands-on depth across ledger, processing, servicing, and fulfillment. You know what each of these is, who the vendors are, and where the operational risk lives.

Deep familiarity with BIN sponsor dynamics, issuer processor mechanics, and card network rules. You can hold a real conversation about a processor migration or a network compliance issue.

Senior plus. Typically 8 to 12 years of experience. Title is not the point. Building the business unit is.

You are willing to be the only person on this for a stretch and then build the function around you.

You can read vendor decks and decide what is real and what is sales theater.

Compensation

Sr. Product Manager II, ClinicalKey Nursing

Would you like to shape AI-first tools that help nurses deliver better care?

Are you ready to connect complex products into seamless healthcare experiences?

About the Team

Join the Nurse Readiness team at Elsevier as we create the next generation of digital experiences for nurses. Our team develops trusted solutions that help nurses access evidence-based knowledge, build confidence, and deliver exceptional patient care throughout their careers. Working alongside clinicians, educators, designers, engineers, and product leaders, we combine Elsevier's world-class content with modern technology to solve meaningful challenges for healthcare organizations worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to shape connected product experiences that simplify workflows, reduce friction, and help customers get more value from the solutions they use every day.

About the Role

As Senior Product Manager, ClinicalKey Nursing, you are a strategic, technically savvy product manager with experience building platform or ecosystem products. You will report to the Vice President of Product and lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of key capabilities within Elsevier's enterprise nursing workspace. You excel at connecting products into seamless customer experiences, influencing across multiple product teams, and translating customer workflows into clear product strategy and specifications. You are a strong collaborator, an exceptional communicator, and comfortable working closely with engineering, UX, and AI-assisted development teams.

In this role, you will play a key role in Elsevier's AI-first product development approach as you identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve discoverability, and introduce shared capabilities that strengthen the overall experience without disrupting the unique strengths of each individual product.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the VP Product and other product leaders on strategic vision, informed by customer research, product analytics, and market insights.

  • Create and execute a roadmap to create a cohesive and intuitive experience across multiple products, in partnership with other product managers across the nursing portfolio.

  • Define platform capabilities that improve navigation, discoverability, personalization, administration, reporting, and overall usability across the Nursing ecosystem.

  • Collaborate with engineering and platform product managers to define platform architecture, including APIs, authentication, shared services, and modular user interfaces that enable products to work together effectively.

  • Lead AI-first, spec-driven product development by translating customer needs, workflows, and business objectives into clear product specifications that guide design, engineering, testing, and delivery.

  • Partner closely with engineering, UX, and AI development teams to iteratively refine specifications, validate assumptions through rapid experimentation, and ensure solutions meet customer needs before implementation.

  • Serve as an advocate for nursing customers, ensuring product decisions reflect real-world workflows and customer needs.

  • Use customer insights, product analytics, and market trends to prioritize investments and guide roadmap decisions.

  • Partner with UX, engineering, clinical, commercial, and content teams to deliver high-quality, scalable experiences that ensure alignment with customer needs, product excellence, regulatory compliance, and successful market delivery.

Requirements

  • 10 years of experience delivering customer-facing SaaS or enterprise software products, with 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.

  • Experience building or managing platform products, integrated product experiences, or enterprise software ecosystems.

  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically across multiple products while balancing customer needs, technical considerations, and business priorities.

  • Strong technical acumen, including experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication, and modern application architectures.

  • Exceptional customer discovery and user research skills, with a passion for understanding customer workflows and translating insights into product strategy.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and build alignment across multiple product organizations.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using product metrics and customer insights to drive decision making.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare technology, clinical workflows, learning platforms, or education technology is a plus.

  • Experience working within AI-assisted software development environments, using structured specifications to guide engineering, testing, and delivery is a plus.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline. Experience in healthcare technology, enterprise software, or education technology is preferred. Masters degree in technical subject (Computer Science or Engineering discipline) is strongly preferred, but not essential.

Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

Fieldguide is the agentic AI-native platform for audit and advisory. We’re establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by putting AI agents to work alongside the practitioners who verify how the economy actually operates.

The profession is facing a structural capacity problem. CPA exam candidates are at a 17-year low, and as many as 75% of today’s CPAs are expected to retire over the next decade, while regulatory complexity and client expectations keep rising. We’re building the system that closes that gap.

We’ve raised over $125M from Growth Equity by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Thomson Reuters, Floodgate, and Y Combinator. More than half of the top-100 U.S. CPA firms are customers, including several Big 4 firms, and we have the NPS to match. Our agents help practitioners save up to 75% of time on manual tasks and unlock over 4x capacity.

We’re deliberate about how we operate. Our FFLOWI values (Fearless, Fast, Lovable, Owners, Win-Win, Inclusive) mean we launch fast and iterate to perfection, we solve problems without red tape, and we hold ourselves to 11-star experiences for customers who cannot afford to be let down.

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Product Strategy & Operations, you’ll be the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market, turning strategy into execution across the product lifecycle. You’ll build the operating systems that help our product teams make better decisions, ship with confidence, and prove measurable impact for the firms betting their delivery model on us.

This is the first dedicated hire in this function. You’ll work as an extension of product leadership, balancing hands-on execution with strategic initiatives, and you’ll build from zero rather than inherit. If ambiguity slows you down, this isn’t the role.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain Voice of Customer systems that synthesize signal from engagement partners, managers, and staff auditors, along with Solutions, Implementation, and Sales, into product signals teams can act on

  • Establish rigorous mechanisms for measuring product success and user impact i.e. dashboards, KPIs

  • Own the analysis behind major product bets: competitive positioning, where agent capabilities should expand next, and the unit economics of running agents at scale i.e. inference cost per engagement, cost-to-serve by segment, and what those trends imply for roadmap sequencing

  • Own and improve core product development processes, tooling, and team rituals: planning cycles, roadmap reviews, monthly business reviews

  • Build run-of-business systems that scale as we grow i.e. launch calendars, intake frameworks, RACI structures

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

Who You Are

  • 6-8+ years in Product Operations, Product Management, product or corporate strategy, consulting, or a closely related operational role at a high-growth tech or SaaS company

  • You’ve built processes and programs from scratch and scaled them thoughtfully, not just inherited and maintained them

  • Strong ability to translate complex qualitative and quantitative data — usage metrics, feedback themes, retention signals — into clear recommendations and roadmap inputs. You can pull the data yourself rather than waiting on a queue

  • Proven ability to drive alignment across Product, GTM, and Engineering without direct authority

More about Fieldguide

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

  • Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

  • Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

  • Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

  • Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

  • Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

  • Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include

  • Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

  • Flexible PTO

  • 401k

  • Wellness benefits, including a bundle of free therapy sessions

  • Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

  • Flexible work schedules

Fractional Project Manager (Part-Time Consultant)

About the Opportunity

Voyage Advisory is seeking an experienced Fractional Project Manager to support a large enterprise client undergoing a significant organizational transformation initiative. This is a part-time consulting engagement for a highly accountable, self-directed project leader who can quickly assess project health, establish structure, drive execution, and help bring a challenged project back on track. This is a great opportunity for a self-employed consulting seeking remote 1099 work. The initial phase of this work is expected to be 10-15 hours per week for 3-4 months with the potential for extension.

The ideal candidate is not someone who requires extensive onboarding or day-to-day direction. Rather, they are a seasoned project professional who applies foundational project management principles, understands what needs to be done, proactively drives progress, escalates issues appropriately, and provides leadership with clear visibility into project status, risks, and decisions.

This role will work closely with senior leadership, Human Resources, talented Organizational Change Management (OCM) professionals, and external consulting partners to support employee training and change adoption initiatives impacting hundreds of employees. While this position is not responsible for developing change management strategy, the Project Manager must understand OCM principles and be able to effectively coordinate and execute OCM-related workstreams.Required Qualifications

  • CAPM certification required.
  • 8+ years of Project or Program Management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects within large enterprise organizations (1,000+ employees).
  • Proven success rescuing, stabilizing, or turning around projects that were behind schedule, off track, or at risk.
  • Experience supporting organizational transformation, organizational redesign, or workforce change initiatives.
  • Experience leading enterprise training initiatives involving 100+ employee populations.
  • Occasional travel to East Coast client locations may be required for key meetings or project milestones.
  • Ability to quickly onboard and become productive with minimal supervision.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-visibility environments where discretion and professionalism are critical.
  • Must be available during standard Eastern Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP certification.
  • Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry experience.
  • Human Resources project experience.
  • Organizational Change Management experience or certification.

What Success Looks Like

  • Quickly establishes structure and accountability within a project environment that requires stabilization.
  • Requires minimal onboarding and little day-to-day oversight.
  • Provides leadership with consistent, transparent reporting and visibility.
  • Proactively identifies and resolves risks before they become major issues.
  • Successfully coordinates complex transformation and training initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Helps bring challenged projects back on track while improving overall execution discipline.
  • Serves as a trusted partner to senior leaders by reducing the need for project oversight and follow-up.

Compensation and Location

This position is a 1099 contract position. Total compensation is negotiable.  The position is primarily remote with possible occasional travel to East Coast client locations.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager
jobs.jd_full:
“In 36 months, agentic AI systems will be an operating reality across major institutions. We intend to be central to it.” — Dr. Jim Rebesco, Cofounder and CEO, Striveworks

The government’s demand for AI is growing far faster than the systems required to support it. Fewer than 15% of federal AI programs have reached sustained production, despite billions of dollars invested. The models perform in testing, but they degrade in the real world. And when performance drops, trust goes with it.

Striveworks was built to solve that problem.

What you’ll build

Since 2018, we have delivered the most trusted AI systems operating in real-world use cases—providing a layer of assurance underneath hundreds of deployed models that monitors performance, manages drift, and sustains systems long after they leave the lab.

As Product Marketing Manager, you will own the collateral that carries our products into every sales conversation, evaluation, and briefing across our AI operations (AIOps) platform, agentic AI orchestrator, and vertical solutions. You will work closely with our product managers, data scientists, and sales team to turn technical substance into collateral that is accurate, compelling, and appropriate for audiences ranging from technical evaluators to senior government decision-makers.

Your day-to-day will include:

  • Owning the collateral library: Maintain a complete, current, and organized library of sales and technical collateral across all products. Identify gaps and drive them to closure.
  • Turning technical input into finished collateral: Work with the PM for each product area to gather technical facts and rough outlines. Independently produce refined presentations and accompanying graphics/diagrams, proactively asking the right questions to fill gaps rather than waiting to be fully briefed.
  • Keeping messaging aligned: Partner closely with the Communications department to ensure that product messaging and collateral align with Striveworks’ broader narratives, voice, and audience dynamics. Support Communications as needed by adapting and developing product content and collateral for different audiences and uses.
  • Supporting event and conference operations: Assist in orchestrating our presence at industry and government conferences, including attendance planning, registration, and booth setup/breakdown, ensuring collateral and messaging are current and conference-ready.
  • Growing into technical content: Partner with product managers, data scientists, and technical teams to produce broader technical content, starting with blog posts.
  • Staying ahead of the curve: Track customer feedback, market trends, competitive capabilities, and emerging technologies to keep collateral and messaging current.

What it’s like here

We lead with trust, treat each other with respect, and use candor consistently, kindly, and constructively. We care deeply about our work, and we find genuine satisfaction in doing it well. Above all, we take ownership—because we feel the weight of collective results personally. We are looking for people who share these values and are eager to put them into practice.

What we’re looking for

  • A bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience, in a technical, communications, or related field
  • 6+ years of product marketing, sales enablement, or technical marketing experience, preferably for enterprise, government, or technical B2B products
  • The ability to understand AI/machine learning, AIOps, and agentic/orchestration concepts well enough to ask sharp questions of product managers and data scientists and represent our products credibly
  • A strong portfolio of written and visual collateral: decks, one-pagers, briefs, or similar assets
  • A proven ability to turn rough, incomplete technical input into polished, decision-ready output with minimal back-and-forth
  • Experience partnering closely with product and technical teams to source accurate content
  • The ability to communicate technical concepts and value propositions to both technical and non-technical senior audiences
  • Strong organizational skills—able to own and maintain a growing collateral library without things going stale
  • A self-starter mindset: comfortable identifying gaps and driving them to closure without heavy direction
  • Due to the nature of this role, candidates must be a US person (a US citizen, a US national, or a Green Card holder)

The following isn’t required, but we’d love to see it:

  • Experience marketing to public-sector, defense, or other mission-driven government buyers
  • Prior experience as a product manager, data scientist, ML engineer, or solutions architect
  • Proficiency with design tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe Creative Suite) to build polished graphics and diagrams
  • Experience producing technical content such as blog posts, case studies, or tutorials

This position offers a fully remote work environment, or you can work hybrid/on site at our office in Austin, TX. You will be expected to travel up to 20% of the time.

Compensation

The anticipated base pay range for this position is $145,000–$195,000/year. Striveworks’ total compensation package includes a competitive base salary, equity grants, and cash bonuses.

Benefits include:

  • Medical/dental/vision insurance
  • Voluntary life, long-term disability, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance
  • HSA and FSA (including dependent care FSA) plans
  • 401(k) plan
  • Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: [REMOTE] Senior Product Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
Description

CrazyGames.com, one of the world’s largest casual gaming platforms with over 60M monthly visitors, is looking for a (full or hybrid) remote Senior Product Analyst in Europe.

Your mission will be to support the product team in identifying problems & opportunities for our 3 million daily users, leveraging the data we collect. You will report to the Chief Product Officer and will work closely with product, data & engineering teams.

On a typical day you might:

  • Work with Product managers to identify and quantify the most important opportunities in our First-Time-User Experience

  • Figure out when users are quitting a game never to come back.

  • Understand how the latest product release are impacting our stats.

  • Work with engineers to identify in what scenarios user progress is not being saved.

  • Combine AB tests data analysis with testing as a user to understand reduced average playtime on certain screen solutions.

Key outcomes for the role:

  • Within 1 month, you have a good understanding of the current product and the data stack, and found 3 quick wins that improve CrazyGames by combining data analysis with user testing

  • Within 3 months, you took responsibility for following up on the effect of our product releases, interpreting positive or negative consequences of changes that our engineering team made as well as communicating those consequences.

  • Within 6 months, you’re meaningfully supporting product managers in quantifying improvement opportunities across our player journeys and choosing the right priorities.

  • Within 12 months, you have improved key product KPIs (conversion to gameplay, lifetime playtime or CURR) by at least 3%.

What we offer:

  • Join the product & data team alongside product managers, designer, analyst and data scientist

  • Work with our elite engineering team of 15+ experienced engineers

  • A modern tech stack on a massive scale (over 300,000,000 gameplays per month across device types from users across the globe)

  • A lot of responsibility and freedom. We hire only experts and trust them to deliver excellent results.

  • Flexible working hours and location. The results are what counts!

  • 1-2 team weeks per year. We pay for flights and accommodation so you can have fun with the team.

  • The opportunity to play games and claim it’s work.

Requirements

Reach out if:

  • You have a strong interest in data-driven digital products and user experience.

  • You can spot patterns in data. You can not leave a question unanswered, or come with a half-baked answer.

  • You know how to gather, process and interpret various data sources to support product decisions (analytics, feedback, trends, user tests, …), and you know SQL very well.

  • You’re used to leveraging AI for efficient analysis, without giving in on critical thinking

  • You are intelligent, efficient, and organized. You have an attention to detail.

  • You like open, efficient, and to-the-point communication and you have experience in working remotely.

Please note: glaring use of GenAI technologies to fill in the screening questions will result in disqualification.

Who we are

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Executive Content & Experiences team builds trusted relationships with leaders shaping the global economy. Preferred qualifications

jobs.title: Remote Project Coordinator / Project Manager - MEP/VDC Construction
jobs.jd_full:
About the Role

We are hiring a Project Coordinator / Project Manager to support U.S.-based MEP construction and VDC projects from coordination through fabrication and installation.

This role is ideal for a construction professional with experience working for a general contractor, mechanical/plumbing subcontractor, or MEP construction company. The successful candidate will coordinate BIM deliverables, project documentation, fabrication workflows, and communication between field, fabrication, engineering, and project teams.

A strong understanding of constructability, MEP systems, Revit-based coordination, and construction execution is essential. This is not a general administrative project management role—it requires direct involvement in technical construction projects and MEP coordination.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate MEP construction and VDC projects, schedules, deliverables, and priorities.
  • Support plumbing, piping, HVAC, and other MEP coordination workflows.
  • Review Revit models, shop drawings, fabrication layouts, spools, and installation documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients, contractors, subcontractors, BIM teams, fabricators, and field personnel.
  • Track RFIs, submittals, clashes, revisions, action items, and project status.
  • Identify constructability issues and help develop practical solutions for fabrication and installation.
  • Monitor project progress and ensure deliverables meet scope, schedule, and quality requirements.
  • Participate in coordination meetings and provide clear updates to project stakeholders.
  • Use Revit to review and coordinate models and project documentation.

4+ years of experience in construction project coordination or project management.

Background with a general contractor, construction manager, or MEP subcontractor.

Experience working on U.S. construction projects.

Strong understanding of MEP construction, BIM coordination, fabrication, or installation workflows.

Proficiency using Revit for model review and coordination.

Experience reviewing shop drawings, fabrication documents, RFIs, and construction documentation.

Strong understanding of constructability and field-oriented project execution.

Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Excellent organization, communication, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently during U.S. business hours.

  • Work for the most exciting companies in the North American Market.
  • Flexible schedules.
  • Work from anywhere.
  • Highly competitive compensation.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Latin America - Remote
jobs.jd_full:
Azumo is looking for a Project Manager to lead software development projects and personalized technology initiatives from inception to delivery.

As a Project Manager, you will be a key player within our IT Delivery team, collaborating cross-functionally with both business and technical teams. You will bring structure, accountability, and technical credibility to every engagement, bridging the gap between engineering teams and stakeholders with clarity and confidence.

This is a hands-on, results-oriented role for someone who thrives on ownership, moves fast, and uses modern tools, including AI, to deliver better outcomes.

The position is FULLY REMOTE, based in Latin America.

Responsibilities:

Project Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of software development projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives, timelines, and budget constraints.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously, maintaining quality and meeting deadlines across all engagements.
  • Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate project risks and blockers, maintaining a live risk log and escalating issues with recommended solutions.
  • Manage vendor and third-party relationships relevant to project delivery, including tracking SLAs and delivery commitments.

Agile Execution

  • Apply Agile, Scrum, and Kanban methodologies to manage project workflows, maintain healthy backlogs, and ensure timely, iterative delivery of software solutions.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives) ensuring actionable outcomes from each session.

Financial & Resources

  • Own billing, time tracking, and budget management across projects, including forecasting and variance analysis.
  • Plan and optimize resource allocation to ensure the right people are on the right tasks at the right time.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and support cross-functional teams through performance coaching, clear communication, and structured problem-solving, fostering a high-accountability culture.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation: timelines, risk registers, status reports, RACI matrices, and resource allocation plans.
  • Communicate clear project updates, escalations, and strategic insights to senior management and stakeholders using structured reporting cadences.

AI- Powered Delivery

  • Leverage AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, Notion AI, and Jira automation, to improve delivery efficiency, generate status reports, assist in documentation drafting, and identify project risks proactively.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience managing software development projects across the full SDLC.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a bias for action.
  • Hands-on experience with JIRA and Notion for project tracking and documentation.
  • Demonstrated use of AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Notion AI, Copilot) in a professional project delivery context.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while consistently meeting deadlines.
  • Professional English proficiency (C1/C2)
  • Based in Latin America.

Nice to have:

  • Previous experience as a Software Developer, Technical Lead, enables tighter collaboration with engineering teams and more accurate technical scoping.
  • Hands-on familiarity with software development workflows: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, API concepts, or sprint-level technical reviews.
  • Experience delivering AI, ML, or data-driven software projects, a meaningful advantage given Azumo’s specialization.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering applied to documentation, reporting, or team productivity workflows.

  • Paid Time Off
  • Mentored Career Development
  • U.S. Holidays
  • USD Remuneration
  • Profit Sharing
  • Maternity Coverage
  • 100% Remote

jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

PSI is a leading Contract Research Organization with 30 years in the industry offering a perfect balance between stability and innovation to both clients and employees. We focus on delivering quality and on-time services across a variety of therapeutic indications.

Job Description

Take your career to the next level and lead challenging full-service clinical research projects in phase II and III, managing the full scope of responsibilities and getting hands-on involvement in every aspect of the study.

Your responsibilities will include:

Make the right call and take your career to a whole new level.  Join the company that focuses on its people and invests in their professional development and success.

jobs.title: Senior Producer / Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Senior Producer / Project Manager

We’re VaynerMedia! We are a contemporary global creative and media agency built for the now. Born in social, our work is now full service, simply loving big ideas that connect and create real change for our clients business. We are independently owned, founded in 2009 with offices in London, Amsterdam, New York, Los Angeles, Singapore, Tokyo, Sydney, Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Mexico City. We are recognized for our work in Cannes Lions, the Clios, D&AD and The Webbies to name a few.

Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it. VaynerMedia EMEA is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time – PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In EMEA, we are proudly 250+, servicing multi-brands across the region.

The PITCH.

We’re looking for a seasoned Senior Project Manager who has a robust understanding of social media and global, fully integrated campaigns, experience with integrated production and a strong project management and operation skillset to help support the day to day running of one of the agency’s major accounts. We would love someone who has experience in both project management and production and feels confident in both spaces. This is an always on role that moves daily, putting out creative content at a fast pace, while also planning larger campaign initiatives.

Here’s where you come in…

  • Take the lead on planning and managing large, complex projects with many workstreams in their entirety, from brief to delivery
  • Taking your project plan and making it a reality by mobilising the best teams (internal and external) around the vision, and providing a clear picture of expected outcomes
  • Responsible for the day-to-day management and execution of the project, both internally and with clients, working closely with each member of the team ensuring each milestone is met on time and within budget
  • Resource management alongside the Creative Director and Resource Manager
  • Tracking financial progression, ensuring it is shared and assessed, taking the lead in suggesting and making adjustments to the project and team as needed
  • Partner with the Account, Strategy, and Creative leads to ensure client expectations, creative vision, and agency needs are met from briefing through final delivery on projects
  • Constantly identifying risks and solutions - being the problem solver in ensuring we remain agile and strategic throughout the project lifecycle
  • May require managing a PM to support the project that you would lead
  • Partner and support our internal creators to execute work to the best quality
  • Oversee production budgets, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and within budget
  • Organise and run pre-production phases including pre-production meetings
  • Manage the post-production and delivery of assets through to final delivery, including tracking status and compliance of everything we produce
  • Lead and schedule necessary project-related meetings such as kickoffs, brainstorms, and reviews, and ensure the right people are seeing the right things before going to client
  • Be client-facing to speak to budget, timing, resource & process considerations
  • On assigned production projects, be the liaison with internal specialty leads (UX strategists, Tech Managers, VaynerSmart, etc) as well as source, contract and manage relationships with vendors
  • Write client SOWs, vendor agreements, change orders, and other contract documents
  • Ensure Agency, Client, Vendor, and Legal processes and requirements are being met
  • Responsible for the management of many variations of ATL and digital and social content (video, image, websites, TVC, print, retail etc.), ensuring quality control, and delivering/trafficking all assets to required agency partners/media teams/clients
  • Overall, being solutions-focused; the go-to person to assess challenges, always identifying the opportunity for possibility
  • Be the first point of escalation for issue/conflict resolution on all projects
  • Grow relationships, have fun and participate in VaynerMedia social engagement

We treasure Personality and Experience yet we do know that these qualifications lead to what WE KNOW as a success:

  • Hands-on experience and ownership of complex strategic projects, requiring senior stakeholder management
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills
  • Budget development and contract (SOW) writing experience
  • Ability to recognise and solve potential problems, escalate issues or conflicts and continually evaluate project effectiveness.
  • Manage overall quality of project delivery and documentation for the account
  • A strong understanding of creative development and asset creation processes
  • A positive, cool, calm and collected approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to thrive and remain agile in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong self-awareness and people-management skills
  • Understanding of different channels, including relevant social media platforms and their requirement

Here’s how We Support You

We regularly review our benefits and are committed to providing a comprehensive programme for our people.

  • Unlimited Holiday + 1 Day Birthday Leave
  • €200 towards a home working allowance
  • €300 towards a social travel allowance to help you meet and collaborate with your team
  • A flexible co-working space for any remote employees wanting to access an office space, and / or for team collaboration days
  • Kick start your mental & physical fitness with 15% extra credits and €30 off a monthly membership with ClassPass.
  • Once you reach 2 years round the Vayner sun, you’re eligible for an annual €150 budget to spend on anything that you’re curious about

What you SHOULD KNOW about VaynerMedia

Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

We believe 100% that brands can be built on digital platforms and part of our model is built bottom up, flipping the traditional advertising model and process on its head. We don’t play to agency/industry norms and our culture and energy reflects that.

Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.

This means that VaynerMedia provides equal employment opportunities to all staff members and job applicants without regard to gender, pregnancy, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, disability, sexual orientation, religious belief, part time or fixed term employment, age or any other legally protected class.
